findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:157` has `theorem mem_map_equiv ... : x ∈ K.map f.toMonoidHom ↔ f.symm x ∈ K`; the PR proof at lines 72-75 is exactly this.
findings.fix: Delete this lemma; use `simpa [basepointChangeSubgroup] using (Subgroup.mem_map_equiv (f := FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) (K := H) (x := g))`.
findings.issue: `mem_basepointChangeSubgroup_iff` is exactly `Subgroup.mem_map_equiv` for `FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ` after unfolding `basepointChangeSubgroup`.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:162` has `theorem mem_map_iff_mem (hf : Function.Injective f) : f x ∈ K.map f ↔ x ∈ K`; the new statement is this with `f = fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ`.
findings.fix: Delete it; use `Subgroup.mem_map_iff_mem (FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ).injective` with `basepointChangeSubgroup` unfolded, or just `simp [basepointChangeSubgroup]`.
findings.issue: `fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath_mem_basepointChangeSubgroup_iff` duplicates Mathlib's membership-under-injective-map lemma for subgroup maps.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:139` has `theorem map_mono ... : K ≤ K' → map f K ≤ map f K'`; the PR body at line 91 is exactly `Subgroup.map_mono hHK`.
findings.fix: Delete it; use `Subgroup.map_mono hHK` after unfolding `basepointChangeSubgroup`.
findings.issue: `basepointChangeSubgroup_mono` is only `Subgroup.map_mono` specialized to the path-conjugation map.

findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Map.lean:196` has `theorem map_le_iff_le_comap : K.map f ≤ H ↔ K ≤ H.comap f`; the PR proof at lines 101-102 is just `rw [basepointChangeSubgroup]; exact Subgroup.map_le_iff_le_comap`.

`mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/Subgroup/Basic.lean:952` has `theorem MulEquiv.normal_map_iff : (H.map (f : G →* G')).Normal ↔ H.Normal`; the new lemma is the same statement with `basepointChangeSubgroup γ H = H.map (fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ)`.
findings.fix: Delete it; use `simpa [basepointChangeSubgroup] using (MulEquiv.normal_map_iff (f := FundamentalGroup.fundamentalGroupMulEquivOfPath γ) (H := H))`.
findings.issue: `basepointChangeSubgroup_normal_iff` duplicates `MulEquiv.normal_map_iff` for the fundamental-group path equivalence, and its long proof rederives Mathlib's normality transport API.

summary: Several new public declarations are unnecessary basepoint-specific restatements of existing Mathlib subgroup/equiv API. These should be removed and the Mathlib lemmas used directly after unfolding `basepointChangeSubgroup`.
